title: Locally constructible subsets of qcqs schemes are constructible
statement: Let $T$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. If a subset $E\subseteq T$ is locally constructible, meaning that every point $t\in T$ has an open neighborhood $V$ for which $E\cap V$ is constructible in $V$ [def-weil-constructible-subset], then $E$ is constructible in $T$.

source.place: Topology, Lemma Tag 053W (lemma-collate-constructible), together with the qcqs scheme spectral-space property (Properties Tag 094L)
